## Change

Describe the failure mode, the chosen boundary, and why this is the smallest useful change.

## Evidence

- [ ] Added or updated a positive fixture.
- [ ] Added or updated a neighboring negative fixture.
- [ ] Used synthetic data only.
- [ ] Documented the first known limitation or evasion.
- [ ] Ran all six offline test suites and the repository self-scan.
- [ ] Ran ShellCheck and Gitleaks.
- [ ] Updated public docs and the changelog when behavior changed.

## Risk

Note false-positive pressure, compatibility changes, new execution paths, and release impact.
